yogas.name: Sunapha Yoga
yogas.description: Planets occupy the 2nd house from the Moon. Bestows mental strength, self-earned wealth, fame, and a prosperous, comfortable life.

yogas.name: Vasi Yoga
yogas.description: Planets occupy the 12th house from the Sun: Mercury. Confers intellectual dexterity, physical resilience, artistic talent, and respected fame.

yogas.name: Kahala Yoga
yogas.description: 4th Lord (Sun) and 9th Lord (Saturn) occupy mutual Kendra positions. Confers tenacious determination, command over organizations or teams, and fearless fortitude.

yogas.name: Neechabhanga Raja Yoga (Jupiter)
yogas.description: Debilitation of Jupiter in Capricorn is cancelled because the lord of its sign (Saturn) is in Kendra (House 7) from Lagna, the lord of its exaltation sign (Moon) is in Kendra (House 1 from Moon), it is exalted in the Navamsa (D9) chart (Cancer). This forms a Raja Yoga conferring ultimate authority, leadership, and great success after overcoming initial struggles.

sade_sati.description: Saturn is transiting directly over your natal Moon (1st house). This is the peak phase of Sade Sati, testing your mental resilience, focus, and core character.
